mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM trade_review WHERE order_id = #{orderId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trade_review (order_id, reviewer_id, seller_id, rating, content, tags, visible) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{reviewerId}, #{sellerId}, #{rating}, #{content}, #{tags}, #{visible})
mapper.update: UPDATE user_credit_summary cs JOIN (SELECT seller_id, COUNT(*) review_count, COALESCE(AVG(rating), 0) avg_rating, COALESCE(AVG(rating >= 4), 0) good_rate, COALESCE(SUM(rating >= 4), 0) good_count, COALESCE(SUM(rating <= 2), 0) bad_count FROM trade_review WHERE seller_id = #{sellerId} AND visible = 1 GROUP BY seller_id) r ON r.seller_id = cs.user_id SET cs.review_count = r.review_count, cs.avg_rating = r.avg_rating, cs.good_review_rate = r.good_rate, cs.bad_review_count = r.bad_count, cs.credit_score = LEAST(100, GREATEST(60, 100 + r.good_count - 3 * r.bad_count)), cs.calculated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, cs.version = cs.version + 1 WHERE cs.user_id = #{sellerId}
